Add the Voidhash MCP server to the AI agents found on this computer: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS
Code and Claude Desktop. It asks which, unless --yes.

No key is written anywhere. The first time an agent uses Voidhash, your browser opens to sign in,
and the agent then acts as you.

Usage:
  voidhash mcp install [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command
  -y, --yes   Add it to every agent found, without asking

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash mcp install
  voidhash mcp install --yes
